name: screenshot-check
description: After UI edits, takes a Playwright screenshot of the page and shows it to Claude.

auto.title: Capture after UI edits
auto.description: Take screenshots by itself a few seconds after Claude edits components, pages or styles, while a dev server runs.

delaySeconds.title: Delay after edits (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: How long the edits must settle before an automatic capture.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: The app's URL, e.g. http://localhost:3000. Empty: the running dev server is found on its usual port.

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of the first screen.

keep.title: Captures kept
keep.description: How many captures to keep in .claude/screenshots; older ones are deleted.
